plotSections.title: Ord forces a gap in the eyed door
bullets: Ord's effect is a reaction, so it can be used only once rather than on each target. It deals 14 radiant damage.
Several eyes on the very edge of the door pop from the damage.
Sylan and Gerk watch Ord step forward, find a gap between the eyes with his hand, and begin to pass through.

chronologicalEvents: Ord learns his effect is a reaction and can be used only once; the result is 14 radiant damage.
Several eyes on the very edge of the door pop.
Ord reaches into a gap between the eyes and begins to pass through while Sylan and Gerk watch.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: Uses a reaction that can be applied only once, dealing 14 radiant damage.
Steps forward, finds a gap between the eyes on the door, and begins to pass through.

Door.existing: A door that stretches reality between places.
notes: Eyes cover the door; several on the very edge pop when struck by Ord's radiant damage.
Ord's hand finds a gap between the eyes, and he begins to pass through.

misTranscriptions.notes: Damage type named as the eyes on the door pop.
